nodes.g: Abel Meholah = "meadow of dancing" a city of Issachar, birthplace of Elisha
nodes.bdb: Abel Meholah = "meadow of dancing" a city of Issachar, birthplace of Elisha

nodes.g: Zattu = "brightness of him" a family of exiles who returned with Zerubbabel
Giddalti = "I make great" one of the sons of Heman, the king's seer
Bazlith or Bazluth = "asking" a head of a family of exiles returning with Zerubbabel
Igal or Igeal = "He redeems" son of Joseph and a spy from the tribe of Issachar son of…
Ashbel = "a man in God: a man of Baal: fire of Bel: I will make a path" second son of…
Meholathite = Mehola "of dancing" an inhabitant of a place evidently named 'Meholah'
Abel Maim = "meadow of waters" a city in northern Israel (perhaps Abel Beth Maachah)
Beth-shittah = "house of the acacia tree" or "place of the acacia" an unknown location…
Zererath = "oppression" a town or territory in Manasseh and the home of Jeroboam
